summary: Jobs run slower than locally because controller dispatches to a node, starts a container and saves output. Update on launch, large projects, internal cluster routing, an Always container pull policy and disks below the required IOPS also delay job start.
questions: Why are jobs slower on controller than on my laptop?
Does container pull policy affect job start time?
How do project size and update on launch slow down jobs?
What disk IOPS does controller need?
